title: Add FP guards: field relocation to tableextension + event parameter addition (bug 642303)
summary: BCQuality adds two false-positive guards to prevent incorrect breaking-change flags when relocating a field to a table extension or adding a parameter to an event publisher.
key_points: Field relocation to table extension is not a deletion and requires no obsoletion
Event parameter addition does not break subscribers that bind by subset matching
Both guards use negative-clarification format to suppress false positives
Scope limited to contract axis; data migration findings remain unmasked
Complements existing event parameter validation rules
